points: In Tishrei, Yishmael ben Nesanyah and ten men sit down to eat with Gedaliah ben Achikam and murder him and his people, out of jealousy. That's the origin of Tzom Gedaliah.
The next day, 80 men from Shechem, Shilo and Shomron come with torn clothes carrying korbanos. The Abarbanel says they knew the Bais Hamikdash was destroyed and still came to bring korbanos.

The Rambam holds korbanos can be brought even without the Bais Hamikdash. In the 19th century Rav Tzvi Hirsch Kalischer pushed to bring them back, and Rav Akiva Eiger considered it. It's still debated today.
Yishmael murders those men too, takes the civilians and the king's daughters captive, and heads to Ammon.
Yochanan rescues the captives. But afraid of Bavel's revenge, everyone starts heading toward Mitzrayim. One jealous man ruined a chance to rebuild right away.
